Pricing

Clear pricing you can trust

Our pricing policy sets us apart as a trusted and customer focussed provider. You simply pay for the resources you use, allowing you to budget your cloud expenses and not be caught out with a big bill of products you don't need. We charge by the hour, so spinning up clusters and databases has never been easier. For more information on our billing, check out our FAQ's.

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Find out more about our transparent pricing model.

How is Civo's pricing structured?

Here at Civo, we are committed to offering users simple and transparent pricing. As a result, all core components of the control plane are free when you sign up, ensuring that your cluster's API and management are always available.

We charge only for the resources used by Kubernetes worker nodes and any additional paid addons like Persistent Volumes or Managed Databases.

Are there any discounts or promotions available for new customers?

At Civo, we offer our new customers $250 of free credit for the first month you sign up.

How are Civo's services billed? Is it hourly or monthly?

We provide our services on a straightforward monthly billing cycle. We can also offer preferential rates and discounts as part of a revenue commitment agreement. To learn more please contact our sales team.

All resource usage is calculated hourly, rounding up to the next full hour. To learn more, check out our billing documentation.

Does Civo apply egress or ingress fees?

At Civo, we do not apply egress or ingress fees or limits, allowing customers to move data freely between Civo and other platforms without any costs or limitations. No caveats, No fineprint. No surprise bill.

Can I add more resources to my existing service plan?

Each account on Civo has a quota based on a combined allocation of instances/Kubernetes nodes, CPUs, RAM usage, and other resources that can be allocated to an account. For detailed instructions on how to manage your quota, refer to the provided documentation.

How do I view and manage my Civo billing and invoicing?

Via your Civo Dashboard, you can view and manage your billing and invoicing. You can also view your current usage, credit balance, billing alerts, and payment methods.

Interested in the subject? This white paper, looking into the complexity of cloud costs for businesses and alternatives beyond the hyperscalers, will give you in depth insight into the cost of cloud in 2022, read the results of this research here.

Are there any discounts or promotions available for customers switching from other Kubernetes service providers to Civo?

Customers can benefit from discounted pricing oncommitted spends. To learn more about how a spending commitment can save your business money, please contact our sales team.
